name: ltspice-mcp
description: LTspice/ngspice circuit simulation and LTspice .asc schematic editing for Claude Desktop. Supports sweeps and Monte Carlo in one request, structured measurements, per-device operating points (gm/gds/vth) by device name, and schematic geometry checks.

allowed_paths.title: Sandbox folder (optional)
allowed_paths.description: Leave blank for no sandbox. Pick a folder to keep the server's tools inside it: they then read and write only there, and a relative path is taken from it.

simulator_exe.title: Simulator executable (optional)
simulator_exe.description: Path to LTspice or ngspice. Leave blank to auto-detect, which works on most native macOS/Windows installs.
